title: How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates
abstract: arXiv:2610.40516v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safety alignment for Large Language Models is heavily focused on English with limited multilingual representation, particularly damaging low-resource language performance. Related open training datasets are often limited in size or do not follow region-localized harmful topics to broaden the scope of alignment beyond cultures. We propose a scalable template-based augmentation pipeline to produce massive multilingual refusal and benign corpora, extracting safe templates from harmful prompts, translating them and then filling in the slots with culturally authentic entities, both harmful and benign. As a result, we release MSafeTemp, a validated corpus spanning 60 languages useful for multilingual safety alignment and evaluation. Using the dataset, we show that English-only evaluation misjudges multilingual safety: for several models, attacks that fail in English succeed once translated, while culturally localized variants expose further

translated_title: 我是如何对齐你的模型的：基于模板扩展多语言安全训练
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型的安全对齐严重聚焦于英语，多语言代表性有限，这对低资源语言的表现造成了特别严重的损害。相关的开放训练数据集通常规模有限，或者未遵循区域本地化的有害话题来将对齐范围扩展到不同文化。我们提出了一种可扩展的基于模板的数据增强流水线，用于生成大规模的多语言拒答与良性语料：从有害提示中提取安全模板，进行翻译，然后用具有文化真实性的实体（既有有害的也有良性的）填充模板槽位。由此，我们发布了MSafeTemp——一个经过验证的、涵盖60种语言的语料库，可用于多语言安全对齐与评估。利用该数据集，我们证明了仅用英语进行的评估会误判多语言安全性：对于若干模型，在英语中失败的攻击一经翻译便能成功，而文化本地化的变体则暴露出更多安全风险。
tldr: 提出基于模板的多语言安全数据增强流水线，发布覆盖60种语言的MSafeTemp安全对齐语料库，并揭示仅用英语评估会误判多语言安全风险。
en_tdlr: Proposes a scalable template-based augmentation pipeline and releases MSafeTemp, a 60-language safety corpus, showing that English-only evaluations misjudge multilingual safety where translated and culturally localized attacks succeed.
